The Property

A quiet stretch of Ocean Gateway, built for staying as long as you like.

M5 Otagi is a cottage-style property just off Ocean Gateway, within easy reach of the beach, the bay, and everything in between. Each cottage stands on its own, with a shared restaurant serving breakfast and lunch, a poolside bar, and palm-lined walkways connecting it all.

We built our leasing around one idea: your plans shouldn't have to outlast your lease. Every cottage here renews on a simple monthly cycle, so you stay because you want to — not because a twelve-month contract says you have to.

Whether you're here for a season on the water or settling in year-round, the terms move at your speed.

Leasing, Simplified

Stay a few days, or stay a while

Book a short visit or settle in on a renewing monthly term — either way, here's how it works.

First

Book your stay

Come for a couple of days, or move in on a standard month-to-month agreement — no multi-year commitment either way.

Then

Confirm before renewal

Around the 20th of each month, we confirm your plans for the next. Staying is the default — a quick nod and your lease rolls forward automatically.

Finally

Leave with 30 days' notice

Ready to move on? Give 30 days' written notice, any month, and close out cleanly. No penalty, no fine print to untangle.

On the Property

Private Cottages

Standalone, single-story cottages with private entries — no shared stairwells or elevators.

An on-site restaurant serving breakfast and lunch daily, open to residents and their guests.

Poolside Bar

An open-air bar beside the pool, on the same lot as the cottages, open evenings for residents.

Private Beach Access

A short path leads residents directly to the shoreline, no crossing the highway required.

Flexible Renewal

Stay a couple of days or lease month to month — reviewed on request, never locked in beyond what you need.
